description: Soft live-check of a ShopAt deal against the retailer page (price/availability heuristics). If stock looks gone, returns may_not_be_available=true and a clear message that the deal may NOT be available — but dismissed is always false (never auto-removes the deal). Also returns cookie_drops (Amazon Associates + Digidip/retailer URLs) for browser clients that can plant affiliate cookies. Agents should warn users when may_not_be_available is true, still share go_url, and never claim ShopAt dismissed the deal from this check alone.
name: precheck_deal
title: Precheck deal availability
